defects.description: The term 'value' is incorrectly translated as 'замечание' (remark/note) instead of 'значение'.
The term 'defaults' is incorrectly translated as 'замечания по умолчанию' (remarks by default) instead of 'значения по умолчанию'.
Incorrect and unnatural translation of the phrase 'analytical-task reviews'. The translator mixed English and Russian in a way that breaks the meaning and grammar.
